protocol.fixture: Existing immutable CRC32C seed, new local cache and process per workload.
protocol.sequential: 256 MiB, 1 MiB reads QD16; CRC on every page.
protocol.mixed: Concurrent fio jobs on disjoint zones: sequential128MiB 1MiB QD16; random4MiB 4KiB QD8 in128MiB. Both fixed work, partial overlap; no stonewall.
protocol.selection_rule: Enable by default only if median sequential p99 improves at least5%, sequential throughput loses at most5%, mixed random p99 rises at most5%; all integrity checks and budget invariants must pass. Short measurements are not statistical proof.
protocol.counter_scope: Successful engine data range GETs/bytes only; excludes metadata, retries and failures. Not total billable operations.
protocol.limits: Two ABBA repetitions on shared VM/provider caches; no global cache purge. No new native, ZeroFS or DB throughput comparison.
